gen-gf-bellota-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Wiry, confident lettering, its s ends flung wide apart. Bellota is best at making a statement in one stylus-width line, while Shippori Antique B1 is best at staying quiet, daylight showing through every curve.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-source-sans-3: Source Sans 3 lets the lower bowl of its a breathe, a modern sans-serif settling in beneath the commanding Bellota. Give the body text a little extra size to match.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-stick: Bellota draws its s with the ends hung far from the spine. Stick, a plain sans of tubelike lines, follows with exits wide enough to pass light, letting the heading's flourish stand out.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-suse: Hand-traced swagger up top from Bellota, its s ends hanging wide of the spine. SUSE, a plain sans with rope-like curves and open bowls, can sit a notch smaller beneath it.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tajawal: Wirelike lines of one thickness, with s ends flung wide, give Bellota its look. And Tajawal, a sans with a broad open hook for its c, keeps the page easy to follow.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tasa-explorer: Bellota sketches every letter as if with a pencil that never presses harder. But the real draw is texture, with TASA Explorer, a sans whose curves stop like lifted brush strokes, echoing that pencil hand.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-teachers: Distinctive from the first letter, Bellota hangs its s ends wide. Bellota is best at commanding attention with one stylus-width line, while Teachers is best at fine, steel-rod letters whose ink strokes taper out.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-varta: Strokes that never pinch at the curves give Bellota its look, while Varta brings big open eyes to every e and a. Text in this sans-serif would read smoothly, without snags.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-wix-madefor-text: Bellota has no vertical emphasis and no horizontal thinning. It is best at headlines with presence, while Wix Madefor Text, a sans-serif with open terminals, is best at reading comfortably.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ysabeau-office: Commanding in tone, Bellota is drawn in true monoline. Ysabeau Office, a plain sans with an open-ended look on every curve, sits underneath and lets that single line lead.
